description: Sleep tracker bedtime and wake-up range with total hours and a goal badge.

"use client" import * as React from "react" import { MoonIcon, SunriseIcon } from "lucide-react" import { Badge } from "@workspace/ui/components/badge" import { Slider } from "@workspace/ui/components/slider" function clock(v: number) { const h = Math.floor(v) % 24 const m = v % 1 ? "30" : "00" return String(h).padStart(2, "0") + ":" + m } export default function SleepScheduleRange() { const [range, setRange] = React.useState([22.5, 30.5]) const hours = range[1]! - range[0]! return (
Bedtime
{clock(range[0]!)}
Wake up
{clock(range[1]!)}
setRange(value as number[])} min={20} max={34} step={0.5} minStepsBetweenValues={8} />
{hours} hours in bed = 7.5 ? "secondary" : "outline"}> {hours >= 7.5 ? "Meets goal" : "Below 7.5h goal"}
) }
